title: Geodesics and thermodynamics of a $κ$-deformed anti-de Sitter black hole surrounded by a quintessence field
summary: We investigate the geodesic structure and thermodynamics of a $κ$-deformed Schwarzschild-anti-de Sitter black hole in a Kiselev quintessence field, where dynamics are governed by a mass-dependent lapse deformation. This term produces an inner Cauchy horizon without requiring charge or spin, yet it fails to resolve the central singularity; instead, the Kretschmann scalar diverges more strongly as $r^{-10}$.
